art: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio - SSAI/Andrew J Christensen, USRA/Helen-Nicole Kostis, NASA/GSFC/Greg Shirah, NAS
desc: NASA’s Orbiting Carbon Observatory, 2 (OCO-2) provides the most complete dataset tracking the concentration of atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2), the main driver of climate change. Every day, OCO-2 measures sunlight reflected from Earth’s surface to infer the dry-air column-averaged CO2 mixing ratio
